source: Static scan of backend/src/ERP.Application/Modules, ERP.Domain/Modules, ERP.Infrastructure (using ERP.* directives) + git log authorship per module folder

method.edgeDetection: Regex match on 'using ERP.(Application|Domain|Infrastructure).(Modules.)?<Name>' per .cs line; edge kept only if <Name> matches an existing modules.json id
method.fanIn: Count of distinct modules with an edge pointing TO this module (Afferent Coupling / Ca)
method.fanOut: Count of distinct modules this module has an edge pointing TO (Efferent Coupling / Ce)
method.instability: fanOut / (fanIn + fanOut) (Robert C. Martin instability metric, 0 = fully stable, 1 = fully unstable)
method.cohesionApprox: intra-module using references / total using ERP.* references found in the module's own files (approximation only -- not method-level cohesion)
method.busFactor: Distinct count of git commit authors (git log --format=%an) across the module's real folders
method.dependencyDepth: Longest outgoing dependency chain reachable from this module (cycle-safe DFS, memoized)
